mentions.name: Self-hosted NAS music streaming site
mentions.description: This self-hosted website, served from a NAS, streams the owner's music file collection like a personal internet radio on the local network, including random playback for rediscovering the collection (with possible future use beyond the local network).
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been vibe coding a way to stream my music files collection. Right now I have a server in my NAS which serves a website that streams my music, like an Internet radio but on my local network.

evidence.value: I've been vibe coding a way to stream my music files collection. Right now I have a server in my NAS which serves a website that streams my music, like an Internet radio but on my local network.
